entities.summary: International Anti-Apartheid Movement, a transformative movement in South Africa (1960–1990). Emerged from Comprehensive Anti-Apartheid Act. Catalyzed Umkhonto we Sizwe Armed Struggle and Township Revolts and States of Emergency.
